The entire proposal document should be AT LEAST 3 pages and no more than 8 pages (including code output, images, and text). 

In an R Markdown code chunk, be sure to use echo = FALSE when you want the code to run but do not want the code itself shown, and use eval = FALSE when you want to display the code without running it. Use message = FALSE and warning = FALSE to hide messages and warnings produced by the code, or use include = FALSE to run the code while hiding the code and all its output. The final document should not contain any R code. 

Use `glimpse()` or `head()` in displaying datasets. You can check a print preview to confirm length.

No R packages are installed or pre-loaded in this Posit Cloud project, so you will need to install and load the packages you want to use. 

## Section 1. Introduction (Data and Research Questions)

#### Using a combination of written text and code chunks/output, make sure you:

-   Tell us where your data comes from, how it was collected, what each row represents, and what are the key variables you are interested in.

-   Describe several research questions that you might answer with this data. Remember, your research questions should have something to do with a meaningful human behavior or psychological process.

-   Be sure to put your data in the /data folder, make sure the notebook includes the output of glimpse() or skim() of your data frame that shows the dimensions of the dataset and the variables you are interested in.

## Section 2. Analysis plan 

#### For each of your research questions, include:

-   Which variables you will use to help answer your questions.

-   Describe the visualizations you will make along with some explanation on how they help you learn more about your data. Feel free to add images (screenshots) to your document to help with the explanation. 

-   What results from these visualizations would help to support different hypotheses?
